item.title: Postgres.app 3alpha9
item.description:
PostgreSQL beta versions usually introduce incompatible on-disk data formats.

Do not install this update if you need to access databases created with PostgreSQL 19beta1 or 19beta2.

If you want to keep your 19beta servers, be sure to dump your databases before installing this upgrade.

  • PostgreSQL 14.24 with PostGIS 3.2.10
  • PostgreSQL 15.19 with PostGIS 3.3.10
  • PostgreSQL 16.15 with PostGIS 3.4.6
  • PostgreSQL 17.11 with PostGIS 3.5.6
  • PostgreSQL 18.6 with PostGIS 3.6.3
  • PostgreSQL 19beta3 with PostGIS 3.7.0rc1

You can find more info on the Github Releases Page.
